function.name: escalate
function.description: Record a request for a claims representative to call the caller back, and alert the claims team. Use it for a request for a person unless your instructions say to transfer, for a yes to a callback that a sentence offered, and after a transfer did not connect. Call it again with callback_phone when its sentence asked for a number. Its result is the sentence for the caller: already spoken, or read out word for word when spoken is false.

reason.description: representative_requested when the caller wants a person or accepted an offered callback; unsupported_question when they accepted a callback for a question you cannot answer; transfer_failed when a transfer did not connect.

details.description: One short sentence on what the caller needs, in plain words. Never a date of birth, a full phone number or an account number.

callback_phone.description: Only when the caller just gave a number to be called back on, or a new caller gave one with their details: the ten digits they said, digits only.

messages.content: Thanks for bearing with me, almost there.
I'm sorry, I couldn't record your request just now. Please call our main line at 1-800-555-0142, and someone there will help you. Anything else I can help with?
